name: log_safety_signal
description: Record a new drug safety signal in the pharmacovigilance signal log for review by the safety team. This writes a permanent record. Include supporting evidence references.

signal_description.description: What was observed and why it may be a signal.

severity.description: One of: low, moderate, serious, critical.

evidence_refs.description: Supporting references: NCT IDs, FDA recall numbers (e.g. D-1234-2025), faers:<drug>, or https URLs.

name: list_safety_signals
description: List previously logged pharmacovigilance safety signals for a drug, newest first, with severity and status.
